name: dobe_drink_key5
desc: keep this pink goo doberman exactly the same pose, size, position and colors. Its head is seen from behind with no eye visible, its muzzle is pursed and pushed straight forward so the muzzle tip is pressed flat into the other face, therefore its mouth is on the far side and completely hidden: no mouth opening, no mouth line, no teeth, no white pixels on the muzzle. The side of the muzzle is smooth pink goo skin. Only a few thin sticky pink goo strands ooze out from the very front tip where the muzzle is pressed and hang down. Same pixel art style.
